notes.title: "Episode.Eddie" has been added to the bundle set of Makoto Sanada's works!
notes.notes:
The Makoto Sanada Bundle Set is now available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29111/

It includes "Angels of Death" and "Angels of Death Episode.Eddie" as well as "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" by the same author and released in November 2022.

This bundle set includes all three titles and is available for less than the price of the individual titles.
And during the Steam Winter Sale, the price is even more affordable!

We hope you'll take the time during the New Year's holiday season to enjoy the stories Makoto Sanada has to offer!


©真田まこと / vaka, Inc.
